## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)
- [ ] contradictions materialised over the resolved spine (new sqitch change; append-only; idempotent) *(deterministic + live-gated)*

## Cross-cutting invariants
Contradictions stay visible (§3.1) — NEVER silently reconciled; append-only (contradiction states =
new rows; resolution is a new lifecycle state, not a deletion); every inference labelled with evidence
on both sides; never publish a total (§32); Part VIII. Reuse-not-reimplement (SIG-ENG-035): the §29
reconciliation (`reconcile/counts.py`), the §31 contradiction object (`reconcile/contradiction.py`),
and the model lifecycle are CONSUMED.

## Plan
- **New sqitch change `contradiction_materialize`** (deps [graph_annotations]): add nullable
  `input_digest` to `contradiction` + partial UNIQUE index `contradiction_input_digest_key`. Mirrors
  `resolution_materialize`/`relationship_materialize` (ADR-099) / `claim_content_digest` (ADR-059) —
  insert-only `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` → idempotent +0. Additive/back-compat (nullable, no default).
- **`reconcile/materialize.py`** — add `materialize_contradictions(conn, ...)`:
  read tier-0 claim groups (reuse `read_claim_groups`), run the §28 `RESOLVE` per (subject, predicate)
  — the SAME detector `api.store_pg._compute_on_read` uses — and materialize a `contradiction` row for
  every genuine conflict (`contradiction_state ∈ {resolved_conflict, unresolved_conflict}` or the
  resolver's own emitted §29.1/§28 `Contradiction`s). CONSUME `reconcile.contradiction.materialize` +
  `derive_contradiction_id` (the §31 entity, stable content-derived identity) and the
  `reconcile.model.Contradiction` lifecycle (`.supersede()`) for the append-only superseding state.
  `contradiction_row` maps any `reconcile.model.Contradiction` → the row (so `reconcile.counts` /
  `reconcile.lifecycle` output materializes through the same writer — reuse, proven by unit tests).
  Mirror the `_persisted_contradictions` shape (contradiction_id, subject_id, predicate_id,
  contradiction_type, status, claim_ids). Both evidence sides live in `claim_ids`.
- **Lifecycle-aware:** a prior OPEN (subject, predicate, type) no longer detected over the current
  spine → a NEW `superseded` state row (via the model `.supersede()`), never a delete/UPDATE of the
  open row (which stays visible in history).
- **`reconcile materialize-contradictions --dsn`** CLI + `read_materialized_contradictions` (the P28.5
  seam feeding the public contradictions surface).
- Live: run over hosted spine if the migration is deployed + an operator role is available; else prove
  on the seeded PG test DB + honest deferral (mirrors P28.1/P28.2).

## Evidence report
The first-class §31 contradiction object is materialized + proven over real PG18+PostGIS: a new
append-only, idempotent (+0), **lifecycle-aware** contradiction write path (`contradiction_materialize`
sqitch change + `reconcile materialize-contradictions`) that runs the §28 resolver — the SAME detector
`api.store_pg._compute_on_read` uses, which itself runs the §29.1 count-basis reconciliation — over the
real (resolved) spine and writes each detected contradiction as a durable, evidenced `contradiction`
row. The signature invariant holds: the 299-vs-190 count disagreement is DETECTED and kept VISIBLE with
BOTH evidence sides in `claim_ids`, never silently reconciled away (§3.1). A contradiction resolved by
later evidence (a retraction recorded by closing a claim's transaction-time interval — the one
append-only mutation the spine permits) is materialized as a NEW `superseded` state row via the model
`Contradiction.supersede()`; the open finding is retained in history, never deleted. §29 reconciliation
(`reconcile.counts`), the §31 entity (`reconcile.contradiction`), and the model lifecycle are CONSUMED,
not re-implemented (SIG-ENG-035) — the writer is a pure mapping over any `reconcile.model.Contradiction`,
proven to materialize `reconcile_counts` and `render_lifecycle_status` output. `read_materialized_
contradictions` is the real, live contradiction dataset the P28.5 surface refresh consumes (the
`_persisted_contradictions` shape). `make check` exit 0 (3666 passed), `make test-db` 162 passed. The
hosted-over-`sig-pg` materialization is honestly deferred (D-R6.3-CONTRADICTIONS, BL-057) with the exact
re-run command — no fabricated hosted count. No new ADR (ADR-099 covers the materialize-at-scale
posture; the §29/§31 semantics are consumed, not newly decided).
